status: Unselected preliminary analysis inputs. No numerical execution, CAD acceptance, structural qualification, complete budget pass or review acceptance is established.
scope: Compare structural topology, tube-member demand, preliminary clearance envelopes, support polygons and whole-stock purchases. Reconcile with actual CAD and the complete vehicle ledger before selecting components or geometry.

provenance.reference_designs: context/reference_designs.md; qualitative precedent only, already inspected; no dimensions or performance inferred
provenance.historical_commercial_envelopes: The previously read cad/pdr_r9_chief/r9_vehicle_layout_candidates_01.json records 279.4 mm and 330.2 mm APC propeller diameters. Only these comparison diameters are retained here. Its top-mounted layout, structural selection and numerical geometry are superseded.

hard_constraints: Exposed minimum structure; no fins, nosecone, cosmetic fairing or enclosing skin.
Spines, battery and avionics above both bottom-mounted rotor envelopes.
Retain a bearing-supported common two-axis gimbal and differential external aerodynamic rotor torque. Ask the human before any conflicting actuation-concept change.
CFRP tripod or quadpod legs attach at a plate or ring just above the gimbal; feet below both propeller planes and stance wider than the disc.
Charge complete minimum purchases for non-exempt vehicle materials, not consumed fractions. PETG filament cost is exempt; PETG mass and structural effects are not.
Unknown masses, costs, interfaces and allowables remain null, never zero. Partial results cannot establish whole-vehicle compliance.

material_sensitivity_inputs.status: Hypothetical engineering sensitivity points, not supplier properties, probability distributions or design allowables

Aluminium_6063_T5.basis: Generic engineering screening assumptions; product-specific material certificate absent

material_sensitivity_inputs.rule: Report sensitivity results separately by construction. Shared trial values do not imply equivalent materials. Do not infer a finished laminate modulus from the 24T label.

geometry_hypotheses.lower_rotor_definition: lower_drop=upper_drop+plane_separation; neutral rotor centres are pivot+[0,0,-drop] in CAD coordinates

spine_layouts.mounting_hypothesis: Central tube with side-mounted equipment and positive-retention brackets; account for eccentric loads and CG
Two rails with equipment between them; assess weak-axis bending and torsion explicitly
Triangular plate stack; confirm rectangular equipment access and interference rather than assuming it fits
Square longerons with equipment plates; bracing and joint shear transfer remain necessary

geometry_hypotheses.leg_construction_rule: For each azimuth, define attachment A at ring radius and attachment Z, and foot-socket reference F at foot radius and Z=20 mm. Let u=(A-F)/norm(A-F). Tube endpoints are A+15u and F-5u. Derive actual tube length and include the extended endpoints in all clearance checks. These insertion hypotheses require later joint design.
geometry_hypotheses.slab_basis: Unverified blade-envelope sensitivity, not hub thickness, measured blade deflection or an accepted blade envelope
geometry_hypotheses.clearance_threshold_status: Study discriminator only; not approved flight margin

moving_support_topology_hypothesis.status: Unselected geometry to assess, not a finished mechanism
moving_support_topology_hypothesis.description: For separate outward-facing motors mounted between rotor planes, a moving outboard yoke must carry the load from the above-rotor gimbal around the upper disc to the between-rotor carrier. A central stationary spine cannot simply pass through the upper propeller swept region.
moving_support_topology_hypothesis.carrier_axial_location: Midway between neutral rotor planes, rotating with the module
moving_support_topology_hypothesis.upper_crossmember_axial_location: At the candidate pivot plane, rotating with the module
required_checks: Moving yoke versus fixed legs/ring throughout travel
Motor, hub, shaft-adapter and linkage fit
moving_support_topology_hypothesis.qualification: Envelope-only hypotheses cannot establish a realizable mount. Include actual support mass, joints and cost before whole-vehicle screening. An integrated coaxial commercial unit is not assumed supplied or selected.

clearance_evaluation_contract.gimbal_sampling: Sample alpha and beta at 1 degree increments, retain only states satisfying the cone, and add the complete cone boundary parameterized at 5 degree azimuth increments. Record the actual sample list and rotation convention.
clearance_evaluation_contract.rotor_representation: Finite circular swept slabs, not just tip points or propeller centre lines. Account for tube radii, slab thickness and extended tube endpoints.
clearance_evaluation_contract.prohibited_shortcut: Checking leg radius only at the neutral rotor plane is insufficient for tilted discs.
clearance_evaluation_contract.conservative_screen: For a rotor slab at pivot offset a, every slab point lies within a sphere centred at the pivot with radius sqrt(R^2+(abs(a)+h)^2). Sphere exclusion may certify a conservative separation; sphere overlap is inconclusive, not proof of collision.
clearance_evaluation_contract.sampled_distance_bounds: If using spatial samples rather than exact solid distances, derive and report a conservative covering-radius bound and subtract it from sampled minimum distance. Without a valid bound, label the result sampled only.
clearance_evaluation_contract.ground_evaluation: For each airframe orientation, transform feet and articulated rotor envelopes consistently, then translate the vehicle vertically until the lowest foot contact surface first touches level ground. Compute both rotor-to-ground gaps in that same configuration. Do not tilt only the rotors or retain an inconsistent foot plane.
clearance_evaluation_contract.ground_allowance_basis: Exploratory compression/terrain/tolerance debit only; not a validated combined allowance
clearance_evaluation_contract.rotor_to_rotor: Use both finite slabs in the common moving frame; distinguish their geometric separation from unverified flexibility and axial runout.
clearance_evaluation_contract.physical_interface_exception: Do not waive an intersection merely because it is near the hub. Intended shaft/hub interfaces require actual bore, adapter, retention and axial-stack evidence.
clearance_evaluation_contract.later_CAD_requirement: Generate and reopen FCStd and STEP; check actual solid distances and interferences, including all mounts, bearings, links, cables and equipment. Retain continuous bounds separately from sampled results.

load_and_stability_sensitivities.status: Proposed screening cases, not agreed structural load requirements
load_and_stability_sensitivities.mass_rule: These are hypothetical complete masses including battery and structure. Do not add computed tube mass to them. Separately report tube-only mass; replace these cases with reconciled CAD-ledger masses later.
load_and_stability_sensitivities.thrust_rule: At resultant tilt theta, total thrust for vertical ratio n is n*m*g/cos(theta). Resolve all forces through actual candidate attachment points.
load_and_stability_sensitivities.landing_force_model: Equivalent vertical point-mass screen: F_average=m*g+m*v^2/(2*s); F_peak=m*g+k*m*v^2/(2*s). This does not model coupled rigid-body contact, rotational energy or measured leg compliance.
landing_contact_cases: All feet on an ideal level plane with symmetric loading
Single first-contact leg assigned the full screening reaction
Quadpod three-foot support subsets; remaining foot unloaded
load_and_stability_sensitivities.lateral_force_basis: Prescribed demand sensitivity, not a measured friction coefficient or a proven stopping force
load_and_stability_sensitivities.member_demands: Project foot reaction onto the splayed leg axis and perpendicular to it. Report axial force, transverse force and root moment. A vertical ground reaction is generally not axial in a splayed leg.
leg_joint_models: Clamped-root cantilever with transverse end load as a labelled demand/compliance model
Pin-ended axial member only if a separate brace/load path actually closes the transverse reaction
stability_outputs: Convex hull of active foot contacts
Minimum and directional signed CG-projection distance to hull edges
Footprint inscribed radius and directional width compared with propeller diameter
Sensitivity to CG eccentricity and missing quadpod contact
load_and_stability_sensitivities.stability_limitations: A wide circumdiameter is not an all-direction support margin. Static tipping calculations do not establish dynamic landing stability or load sharing on uneven ground.

member_analysis_contract.section_formulae: A=pi*(Do^2-Di^2)/4; I=pi*(Do^4-Di^4)/64; J=2*I; use SI lengths
outputs: Tube volume and density-sensitive installed mass
Euler load pi^2*E*I/(K*L)^2 with stated boundary model
Nominal axial and bending stress demands
Cantilever displacement under the stated load model
member_analysis_contract.spine_assembly_comparison: Report independent-member bending sum and an ideal perfectly shear-coupled E*sum(I+A*d^2) section proxy in both directions. Neither is a validated assembly stiffness or a guaranteed bound on a jointed unbraced frame. Include joint slip, plate flexibility and bracing as unresolved effects.
member_analysis_contract.torsion: Do not infer assembly torsional stiffness from rail separation alone. Report member GJ only until a shear-transfer model exists.
member_analysis_contract.CFRP_limitations: Simple beam stresses are nominal demands, not laminate failure indices. Crushing, splitting, delamination, local shell buckling, fatigue and joint eccentricity remain unassessed.

purchase_and_mass_accounting.cutting_method: Group all spine and leg cuts by exact product ID. Pack cuts into whole stock lengths with end trims and a conservative kerf per cut. Retain the cut assignment and unused length for every purchased tube. Do not charge shared stock twice or reuse offcuts across incompatible product identities.
purchase_and_mass_accounting.optimization_reporting: Report a lower bound and achieved stock count. Label a heuristic result as such; claim optimality only with an exact search or matching lower bound.
pricing_cases: Displayed-price stock subtotal with no tax deduction
Tax-exclusive calculation only where the applicable currency and GST basis are explicit
purchase_and_mass_accounting.unconfirmed_currency_rule: An inferred AUD amount is a provisional sensitivity subtotal, not a confirmed AUD budget result.
purchase_and_mass_accounting.roll_wrap_rule: Use the labelled upper-range allowance only for sensitivity; exact variant quotation remains null.
purchase_and_mass_accounting.rounding: Use decimal arithmetic for currency; retain unrounded calculation internally and report rounding policy with totals.
purchase_and_mass_accounting.tube_mass_rule: Installed tube mass uses finished length and section area, not purchased stock mass. Procurement uses whole stock purchases, not installed fractions.

execution_and_verification_contract.next_program: Create an editable sandbox-only computation that reads this JSON, validates units and dimensions, enumerates the declared alternatives and retains its actual input hash.
analysis_result_requirements: Record every explored candidate ID and rejection reason
Separate exact calculations, conservative bounds, sampled checks and unresolved checks
Report stock schedules, demand/stiffness sensitivities and geometry witnesses
Do not silently drop failed candidates or missing inputs
Do not select a winner inside the numerical program
execution_and_verification_contract.verification: Retain a separate editable checker. Use verify_command with every tested artifact Ref in inputs. Stdout must contain only VerificationResult JSON; diagnostics go to stderr. Test actual inputs/results and analytical fixtures, including a deliberately colliding geometry and an overlength stock cut.
execution_and_verification_contract.selection_gate: Chief reviews numerical and CAD results, reconciled installed mass, procurement and actuation interfaces before recording a preliminary engineering selection.
execution_and_verification_contract.physical_tests: Material/joint qualification, loaded gimbal travel, blade clearance under load, restrained propulsion endurance and landing tests remain unperformed.
